protocol.selection: fixed after E10: two stable J cases, stable S case, geometric tie, win-direction flip
protocol.fixed_probes: initial plus all strict best-seen improvements plus final sequences, complete-signature deduplication
protocol.method_order: J/S alternates by (repeat + fixed state index) parity

timing_semantics: 12 second clocks start after exact copies of one complete shared incumbent, and after cold cache creation
layout_plan_seconds measures the SiteLayout planning/cache route; task_time_decode_seconds measures TaskTime calls
field_decode_microseconds includes both layout and task-time work; rail_repair_microseconds includes nested field decodes
field-total and rail-total overlap and must not be summed; candidate-total is the inclusive decode time
measurement hooks and JSON timeline collection add instrumentation overhead; these measurements are not merged with historical E10 timing
